_comment_roles: roles.realm is injected from shared/authz/generated/keycloak-roles.json by `make keycloak-realm` — see permissions.yaml, the single source for DAMP's RBAC model. Do not hand-edit a roles list here; it will be overwritten.
_comment_groups: Orgs live under /orgs/<slug> as Groups, created at runtime by services/identity when an organization is onboarded (POST to the Keycloak Admin API) — not seeded here. The parent group exists so every org has a consistent path prefix and so the org_id attribute mapper below has somewhere to read from. damp-demo-co is one seed example so 'company@damp.local' below has an org_id to log in with.

clients.name: DAMP Portal (frontend)
clients.description: Public SPA client — matches frontend/public/runtime-config.js. PKCE pre-configured; directAccessGrantsEnabled stays on until authUtils.ts migrates off password grant (see docs/building-plan.md P1).
clients._comment_description: Kept under Keycloak's 255-char DESCRIPTION column limit (a dev-mode H2 schema constraint that bit the first, longer draft of this string) — see docs/building-plan.md's P1 note on migrating grant_type:'password' to auth-code+PKCE for the full rationale.

protocolMappers.name: aud-mapper-damp-portal
protocolMappers._comment: Mandatory — see docs/building-plan.md's P1 section. Without this, Keycloak issues aud: ["account"] for a public client and services/auth-proxy's JWT verification rejects every request. This is 'the single most likely day-one bug' per the plan.

protocolMappers.name: org-id-group-attribute
protocolMappers._comment: org_id is set on the user (copied from their org Group's org_id attribute by services/identity at membership time), not read live from group membership on every token issuance — a user can belong to exactly one primary org for token purposes.

clients.name: services/identity (confidential)
clients.description: Service account with Keycloak Admin API access, scoped to exactly the realm-management roles services/identity needs (fullScopeAllowed off).
clients._comment_secret: Dev-only placeholder. A real environment injects this via a secrets manager, never commits it — see docs/building-plan.md's P6 key-custody phase for the pattern the rest of the platform's secrets follow.

_comment_clientScopeMappings: identity-service's service account HAS these realm-management roles via users[].clientRoles below, but fullScopeAllowed:false on the client means having a role isn't enough for it to appear in that client's own tokens — it also needs an explicit scope mapping granting it permission to include them. Without this, KeycloakAdminClient.getUser()/getUserGroups() 403 and JIT provisioning (services/identity/src/provisioning) can never complete a first login.
_comment_users: Six seed users, one per DAMP role, for local dev/demo login (matches the P1 DoD in docs/building-plan.md: 'log in as customer@damp.local' / 'compliance@damp.local'), plus one synthetic service-account user granting identity-service's client its realm-management roles — that's how a client's service account gets roles in a realm import, there's no serviceAccountRoles field on ClientRepresentation itself. Password is the dev-only literal below for every human seed user — never used outside a local --import-realm bootstrap.
